title: Bay of Plenty
description: Bay of Plenty: national scan on the LINZ 8 m DEM, 15 tiles of 64 km

sections.source: Commercial rafting listings describe the dam-release Wairoa as Grade 5. Extent: NZ RiverGuide 'McLaren Falls to Powerstation' (put-in below McLaren Falls; take-out 2.7 km down the river, the guide's length, because the guide's inferred Ruahihi take-out snaps onto the Omanawa). Was the whole steep river by name until rf-aq6.27.
Sean: one of the top Kaimai runs (spelled Tuakopai locally). Grade not recorded yet.
Sean: known locally as a flood run; not in online guides. Held out from training.
Karangahake Gorge: Class IV-IV+ bouldery rapids above Karangahake, flood only (industry report). Extent approximate: 4 km above Karangahake.
